$comment: Manual commercial qualification for the first wave. Separate from the automated score. Every verified finding carries its source and access date; everything else is an open question. ready_for_discovery means worth a first conversation, not a qualified lead. Sources were read by Ayo Ahmed on the date given; the raw source ledger is held outside the repository. Field definitions: schema/qualification.schema.json.
